summary: 3DNow! vector interpolation between two input vectors a2 and a3 with parameter a4, writing the result to a1. Computes the dot product, extracts its sign and magnitude, and branches on |dot|: when |dot| is small enough (<= ~0.9999) it takes the full path computing 1/sin(theta) via pfrsqrt(1-dot^2) with Newton-Raphson refinement (F_3DVectorNormalize_8f00, sub_529700) to build sin-based blend weights; otherwise it uses the simple (1-t, t) weights. The final per-lane products (weight-a2 and weight-a3, lanes combined with sign restoration) are written to a1->m64_u64 and a1[1].m64_u64.

local_names.a1: output vector (two 64-bit lanes at this+0 and this+8)
local_names.v8: sign mask lane extracted via pfcmpge and the 0x8000000080000000 mask
local_names.v9: |dot| (dot with the sign mask XORed off)
local_names.v10: 1 - dot^2 (pfsubr of v9*v9 from the packed 1.0 constant)
local_names.v6/v5: sin-based blend weights derived from the parameter and the refined reciprocal-sin factor

operations.description: _m_femms() at entry to switch the CPU into MMX/3DNow state.
Dot product v4 = a2[0]*a3[0] + a2[1]*a3[1] built from per-lane pfadd(pfmul) of the two 64-bit halves of a2 and a3.
Broadcast the parameter: v5 = cvtsi32_si64(a4), and compute v6 = 1.0 - t by subtracting v5 from the packed 0x3F800000 (single-precision 1.0) constant.
Horizontal fold v7 = pfacc(v4, v4) collapses the two dot lanes; v8 = pand(pfcmpge(0, v7), 0x8000000080000000) extracts the sign lane; v9 = pxor(v7, v8) yields the magnitude |dot|.
Branch on pfcmpge(0x3F7FFF58 (packed ~0.9999), v9): the full slerp path runs only while |dot| stays below the near-parallel threshold.
v11 = pfrsqrt(v10), the reciprocal square root approximating 1/sin(theta).
F_3DVectorNormalize_8f00() performs a Newton-Raphson refinement step on the intermediate.
First sub_529700() helper call advancing the interpolation computation.
Fold the parameter into the weights: v20 and v12 combine a4 and (1.0 - t) with the reciprocal-sin intermediate.
Second sub_529700() helper call completing the refinement stage.
v13 = refined reciprocal-sin factor (Newton-Raphson via pfrsqit1/pfrcpit2); v6 and v5 are then scaled by v13 into the final sin-based blend weights, and the sign lane v8 is re-derived.
result = a1; v15 = pxor(v5, v8) restores the signed weight; v16/v17 duplicate the two blend weights across both lanes via punpckldq.

Per-lane lerp: lane products (weight-a2[0], weight-a2[1], weight-a3[0], weight-a3[1]) are multiplied and summed so the first lane is v18 + weight-a3[0] and the second is the pfadd of the two lane terms.
Write the interpolated lanes: a1->m64_u64 (this+0) gets the first combined lane and a1[1].m64_u64 (this+8) gets the second.
_m_femms() at exit to leave the MMX/3DNow state.
Return a1 (the output vector pointer); called from MMX3DNowVectorTransform and F_3DVectorBlend.
